features.title: Specialist assistants
features.summary: Choose a role, set up its Main instructions and three subchats, and try a first task.

instructions.install: Download the specialist ZIP and extract it into a new folder.
instructions.configure: Open START_HERE.md and follow the guide for Main and three subchats.
instructions.health: Try the first task with a small brief and check the result against the included guidance.
instructions.failure: Compare the current instructions with the original kit and your saved customizations.
instructions.stop: End the current task and save any results you want to keep.
instructions.uninstall: Back up your instructions and saved work, then remove the assistant through its host settings.

features.title: Skills and workflows
features.summary: Find a method, add it to the relevant specialist, and follow a repeatable sequence.

instructions.install: Choose a skill or workflow from the library and download its package.
instructions.configure: Read the inputs, required tools, and expected output; add the method to the relevant specialist.
instructions.health: Run the worked example and compare the result with its expected output.
instructions.failure: Check missing inputs and tool setup, then retry only the step whose result is unresolved.
instructions.stop: Stop at the next review point and save the work completed so far.
instructions.uninstall: Keep your outputs and customizations, then remove the skill through the host or delete its extracted copy.

features.title: Apps and connections
features.summary: Find setup instructions for the services you want to use.

instructions.install: Choose a connector and follow its publisher's setup guide.
instructions.configure: Select the account and permissions required for your task.
instructions.health: Try a read operation and check that it returns the expected account and records.
instructions.failure: Inspect the service response and connection settings before repeating an action.
instructions.stop: Stop the current operation through the connected service when necessary.
instructions.uninstall: Disconnect the account and revoke unused permissions through the service settings.

features.title: Muse in your terminal
features.summary: Chat with your personal Muse, work with side chats, and read history.

instructions.install: Follow the terminal guide to install the client for your operating system.
instructions.configure: Connect your Muse account using the client's documented sign-in steps.
instructions.health: Open a conversation, send a short message, and read it back in history.
instructions.failure: Check the client version and account connection, then inspect the original conversation before resending.
instructions.stop: Exit the client or stop its foreground command.
instructions.uninstall: Remove the client through its installation method and revoke a connection through its account settings when needed.

features.title: Companion Home
features.summary: Move between five rooms, save notes, animate shapes in Studio, and play Signal Trail.

instructions.install: Use a toolkit checkout with Python 3.12+ and follow the Companion Home launch command.
instructions.configure: Choose a private database path, open the printed URL on the same computer, and enter the session token.
instructions.health: Save a room note, switch rooms, and reopen it. Try the Studio controls and an Arcade turn.
instructions.failure: Refresh saved notes after an interrupted save and compare a newer revision before editing.
instructions.stop: Press Ctrl+C in the launcher terminal. Lock Notebook to hide the current session.
instructions.uninstall: Keep or back up the database before removing the application folder.

features.title: Daily Desk
features.summary: Save tasks and notes, resolve edits, and back up or restore your desk.

instructions.install: Use a toolkit checkout with Python 3.12+ and run the Daily Desk launch command.
instructions.configure: Choose a private database path and enter the printed token in the local page.
instructions.health: Create a task and note, reopen them, and restore a backup into a new database.
instructions.failure: Use Check saved receipt before retrying an interrupted save; inspect the original destination after an interrupted restore.
instructions.stop: Press Ctrl+C in the launcher terminal. Lock session to hide the current workspace.
instructions.uninstall: Download a backup and retain the database before removing the application.

features.title: Family Link
features.summary: Prepare a specialist handoff with clear context, a recipient, and the result you need.

instructions.install: Download the Family Link kit or use the included toolkit example.
instructions.configure: Choose the receiving specialist, task, relevant sources, and expected result.
instructions.health: Review the handoff, send it through your chosen route, and check the recipient's returned result.
instructions.failure: Check the original delivery result before repeating a send; keep the operation ID for reconciliation.
instructions.stop: Stop the handoff in the selected communication route and retain the current task state.
instructions.uninstall: Keep any needed task records, then remove the extracted kit and revoke unused service connections.

features.title: Creative Studio
features.summary: Turn a brief into shots, asset dependencies, continuity checks, and a storyboard.

instructions.install: Extract the Creative Studio kit into a new folder and use Python 3.12+.
instructions.configure: Copy the sample brief to your project folder and set the scenes, assets, timing, and rights.
instructions.health: Compile the brief, open the storyboard, and check the shot list and continuity report.
instructions.failure: Resolve the reported scene or dependency conflict and compile into a new output folder.
instructions.stop: Stop the foreground command and retain the brief and completed outputs.
instructions.uninstall: Keep project files outside the kit and remove only the extracted application folder.

features.title: Resource library
features.summary: Search community tools and projects by task or platform.

instructions.install: Open the resource library from Muse Hub.
instructions.configure: Choose a task or platform filter and enter a search term.
instructions.health: Open a result and follow its project setup guide; copy the filtered URL to return later.
instructions.failure: Clear the filters if no result matches, or check the original project for updated instructions.
instructions.stop: Close the page or clear its filters.
instructions.uninstall: Remove any saved browser bookmark when it is no longer needed; manage installed tools through their own setup instructions.
